units.source_text: 命妇便将太君所赐礼物呈请御览。

en.t: The court lady then presented the gifts bestowed by the Grand Lady for His Majesty to inspect.
After the emperor looked at them, he thought:

units.source_text: “这倘若是临邛道士探得了亡人居处而带回来的证物钿合金钗……”

en.t: "If only these were the jeweled box and gold hairpin brought back by the Taoist priest of Linqiong, proof that he had found the dwelling place of the dead..."
[17] But even to indulge in such empty fantasies was futile.
Then he recited a poem, saying:
